Hi Leah — thanks, great to hear.

Short answer: yes, we can consider a temporary invoice-only lane (no PO) for small pilots, but we run an evidence sweep first. Our procurement/finance guardrails require a few baseline items to approve a short-term exception:

- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax docs
- Vendor profile with legal name and remittance info
- Bank account verification or voided check for ACH (or confirmation of payable email + credit card setup)
- Signed SOW or email confirming scope and expected spend (<= $10k recommended for autopolicy)
- Point of contact for invoicing and a public billing email

If you can drop the W-9 and corporate profile in Drive or reply here as attachments we’ll start the review. I’m looping in Kimberly (procurement) and Priyom (finance ops) to expedite.

Plan: Priyom will do an initial docs check; Kimberly will confirm risk tier and temporary spend cap; if all good Marissa (ops approvals) will sign off on a 90-day exception with a spend cap.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
